# Backspace Fork 1.15.8

## Changes

- **No more phantom "listening to music" while screen sharing:** the desktop app no longer reports its own media sessions as activity. Any in-app audio element used to surface as a playing session titled "Backspace Fork" and shadow real music for the whole share; those sessions are now skipped. Remote camera tiles also render muted (they are video-only; all voice audio already flows through the Web Audio pipeline).
- **Watch controls moved into the profile popout:** the sidebar Assistir button is gone — clicking a person in a voice channel still opens their profile, and a member who is sharing a screen now offers **Assistir** right below the @name (replaced by **Parar de assistir** while watching, hidden when they share nothing, when it is you, or when the id is ambiguous across federated origins).
- **Channel-bound watches:** a watch now records which voice channel it belongs to, subscribe/stop act only in that channel's room, and watching a channel you are disconnected from reconnects it first.

## Compatibility and operations

- No database migration and no minimum desktop version increase in this release. Back up the database before updating; existing users, uploads and instance identity must be preserved.
- Same-id users on different federated origins: when the shared presence cannot tell whose screen is live, the popout offers no watch button rather than driving the wrong room. Keying that presence per origin is tracked follow-up work, not part of this release.
- Desktop installers for this tag are built and published by the release workflow once tag CI is green.
